# Cureus Journal of Medical Science

> > Cureus is a peer-reviewed, open-access medical science publishing platform covering diverse clinical and research disciplines.

Cureus Journal of Medical Science is a comprehensive open-access medical publishing platform that provides peer-reviewed articles, case reports, and clinical research across multiple medical specialties. The journal serves as a central hub for healthcare professionals and researchers to publish and access cutting-edge medical science.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
- Peer-reviewed articles
- Clinical research
- Medical case reports
- Medical science
- Peer-reviewed journal
- Research articles
- Medical publishing
- Case reports
- Clinical medicine
- Healthcare research
- Medical education
- Evidence-based medicine
- Interdisciplinary medicine

## Core Platform

- [The Cureus Journal of Medical Science: Peer-Reviewed, Open Access](https://www.cureus.com): Cureus Journal homepage: peer-reviewed open-access medical science publishing platform

## Clinical and Surgical Specialties

- [Cardiac / Thoracic / Vascular Surgery Journal](https://cardiac_thoracic_vascular_surgery.cureus.com): Cardiac, thoracic, and vascular surgery research section of Cureus
- [Cardiology Journal](https://cardiology.cureus.com): Cardiology and cardiac conditions research section of Cureus Journal
- [Surgery Research Journal](https://general_surgery.cureus.com): General surgery and surgical research section of Cureus Journal
- [Anesthesiology Journal](https://anesthesiology.cureus.com): Anesthesiology research and perioperative care section of Cureus Journal
- [Emergency Medicine Journal](https://emergency_medicine.cureus.com): Emergency medicine and trauma care research section of Cureus Journal
- [Gastroenterology Journal](https://gastroenterology.cureus.com): Gastroenterology and digestive health research section of Cureus Journal

## Internal Medicine and Specialties

- [Endocrinology Journal](https://endocrinology_diabetes_metabolism.cureus.com): Endocrinology and diabetes research section of Cureus Journal
- [Allergy and Clinical Immunology Research](https://allergy_immunology.cureus.com): Allergy and clinical immunology research section of Cureus Journal
- [Family Medicine Journal](https://family_general_practice.cureus.com): Family medicine and primary care research section of Cureus Journal

## Anatomical and Dermatological Sciences

- [Anatomy Research](https://anatomy.cureus.com): Anatomy research and anatomical studies section of Cureus Journal
- [Dermatology Journal](https://dermatology.cureus.com): Dermatology and skin conditions research section of Cureus Journal
- [Dentistry Journal](https://dentistry.cureus.com): Dentistry and dental science research section of Cureus Journal

## Public Health and Environmental Sciences

- [Epidemiology Journal](https://epidemiology_public_health.cureus.com): Epidemiology and public health research section of Cureus Journal
- [Environmental Health Research](https://environmental_health.cureus.com): Environmental and occupational health research section of Cureus Journal
